display.purpose: Hero headlines only — Sora, tight tracking, one per view.

title.purpose: Card and section headers, step titles — Sora.

body.purpose: All prose and control text — Nunito, ~68ch measure.

label.purpose: Uppercase wide-tracked micro-labels, kickers, step indices — Nunito 700.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Default float for every .gb-card and panel — diffuse daylight, not drop-shadow.

shadows.name: accent-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the primary gradient button; sky-tinted to belong to the button's own color.

shadows.name: mark-lift
shadows.purpose: Under the teal brand logo tile.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Soft teal halo on focused inputs and active steps — the state signal, replaces the browser outline.

motion.name: state
motion.purpose: Border and ring transitions on focus/active.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one accent action per screen — teal→sky gradient, sky-tinted lift.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.62rem 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #fff; background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0ea5a4, #0284c7); box-shadow: 0 10px 20px rgba(3,105,161,0.25); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,0.35); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Translucent teal wash for secondary actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { border: 1px solid rgba(14,165,164,0.25); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.62rem 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; background: rgba(14,165,164,0.09); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(14,165,164,0.45); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,0.2); }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Translucent white, hairline border — lowest-emphasis action.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.12); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.62rem 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 0.18s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: rgba(14,165,164,0.3); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,0.2); }

components.name: Frosted Card
components.description: The universal surface — translucent glass over the gradient, soft wide lift.
components.html:
Extraction results

12 fields read from your I-20.
components.css: .ds-card { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.82); border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.12); border-radius: 18px; box-shadow: 0 18px 40px rgba(8,47,73,0.12); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); padding: 1.3rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.5rem; font-family: 'Sora','Nunito',sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: #0f172a; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; color: #4f6479; font-size: 0.92rem; line-height: 1.45; }

components.name: Field Input
components.description: Uppercase label over a near-opaque input with a soft teal focus ring.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.35rem; } .ds-field span { font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.06em; color: #4f6479; } .ds-field-input { width: 100%; border-radius: 10px; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.95); padding: 0.6rem 0.72rem; font-size: 0.92rem; color: #0f172a; } .ds-field-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: rgba(14,165,164,0.6); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(45,212,191,0.14); }

components.name: Chip
components.description: Pill tag — teal wash for tags, sky wash for actions.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; border: 1px solid rgba(14,165,164,0.25); background: rgba(45,212,191,0.11); color: #0f766e; border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.3rem 0.62rem; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: default; } .ds-chip-action { border-color: rgba(2,132,199,0.24); background: rgba(125,211,252,0.16); color: #0369a1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip-action:hover { border-color: rgba(2,132,199,0.5); }

components.name: Status Pill
components.description: Dot + label state pill; ok teal-green, bad red.
components.html: Auto-accepted Needs review
components.css: .ds-pill { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.35rem; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.94); border-radius: 999px; padding: 0.35rem 0.7rem; font-size: 0.78rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-pill-ok { border-color: rgba(14,165,164,0.35); color: #0f766e; } .ds-pill-bad { border-color: rgba(185,28,28,0.35); color: #991b1b; } .ds-pill-dot { width: 6px; height: 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: currentColor; }

components.name: Stepper Step
components.description: The spine of every multi-step flow — index, Sora title, subtitle; active carries the teal ring.
components.css: .ds-step { width: 100%; text-align: left; border: 1px solid rgba(15,23,42,0.12); background: rgba(255,255,255,0.84); border-radius: 12px; padding: 0.72rem 0.82rem; display: grid; gap: 0.12rem; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease; } .ds-step:hover { border-color: rgba(14,165,164,0.38); } .ds-step-current { border-color: rgba(14,165,164,0.3); box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px rgba(45,212,191,0.16); } .ds-step-index { font-size: 0.73rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.08em; color: #0284c7; font-weight: 700; } .ds-step-title { font-size: 1.05rem; font-family: 'Sora','Nunito',sans-serif; font-weight: 700; color: #0f172a; } .ds-step-sub { font-size: 0.86rem; color: #4f6479; }

narrative.overview: Globalदोस्त looks and feels like clear water over a calm aqua-to-sky floor. Frosted-glass surfaces float above a soft two-radial gradient; you can see the light coming through everything, and nothing is hidden behind an opaque panel. That translucency is not decoration — it is the product thesis made visible: a machine extracts a legal document, admits how sure it is about each field, cites the source region, and refuses to proceed when it isn't sure. The system is airy and floating — translucent white surfaces with real backdrop blur, generous 18px rounding, soft low-wide daylight shadows, pill-shaped controls that rise 1px on hover. Type pairs Sora (display, confident) with Nunito (body, warm). The one place airiness yields is the confidence and review surfaces: the glass stays but the information hardens into unambiguous, color-coded state. Calm is the resting tone; it never softens a warning.
keyCharacteristics: Frosted-glass translucent surfaces over a soft aqua→sky radial-gradient page
One teal→sky accent gradient, spent only on the primary action per screen
Pill-shaped controls (999px) and generously rounded cards (18px)
Soft, wide, low-opacity shadows — daylight, not drop-shadow
Sora display + Nunito body; wide-tracked uppercase micro-labels
Warmth at rest, unambiguous color the moment stakes or uncertainty appear

rules.name: The One Gradient Rule
rules.body: The teal→sky gradient appears once per screen, on the single primary action. Everything else is flat translucent glass. Its scarcity is what makes the primary action unmistakable.

rules.name: The Palette-Locked State Rule
rules.body: Success is deep teal-green (#0f766e), never a stock #22c55e; info is sky; warning is ochre; danger is #b91c1c. State colors are chosen to belong to this palette.

rules.name: The Sora-For-Structure Rule
rules.body: Sora is only for display and titles. Body, labels, controls, and data are always Nunito.

rules.name: The Glass-Over-Gradient Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are translucent white with a real backdrop blur, always floating over the aqua→sky gradient — never opaque, never flat-white.

rules.name: The Lift-On-Hover Rule
rules.body: Buttons and interactive cards rise translateY(-1px) on hover; the resting state is calm, motion confirms interactivity.

dos: Do keep every surface translucent glass over the gradient — rgba(255,255,255,0.82–0.94) + backdrop-filter blur.
Do spend the teal→sky gradient on exactly one primary action per screen.
Do set headings and titles in Sora, everything else in Nunito.
Do use fully-round pills (999px) for buttons, chips, badges; 18px for cards, 10–12px for inputs.
Do signal focus and active state with the soft teal ring + teal-tinted border-strong, never a hard outline.
Do keep semantic colors inside the palette: Success-Ink teal-green, Signal Sky info, ochre warning, #b91c1c danger.
Do harden the confidence/review surfaces: an uncertain, high-stakes, or policy-flagged field must be unambiguously color-coded.
donts: Don't use opaque flat-white panels or hard drop-shadows.
Don't introduce a second accent gradient or a third accent hue — the world is teal + sky only.
Don't set body text, buttons, or labels in Sora.
Don't use pure black (#000) for text — ink is Deep Slate (#0f172a).
Don't show a raw confidence number as if it were a probability; carry its match label and cited source region.
Don't let the calm palette soften a warning: a needs-review or policy-change state is never in a reassuring color.
